title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
text: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

title: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
text: A new online archive of Esther Mahlangu’s life and art is now on Google Arts & Culture.

title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
text: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
text: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
text: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
text: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
text: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
text: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
text: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
text: Gemini Intelligence is rolling out to more devices. See how expanded capabilities across these devices help you do more.

title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
text: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
text: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
text: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
text: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
text: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
text: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
text: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
